## Scientific change

State the research objective, mathematical assumptions, data-vintage convention and exact code paths changed.

## Evidence and reproducibility

- [ ] Tests added or updated (or documented why not applicable)
- [ ] `pytest`, `ruff`, structure check, and Sphinx run (or unavailable noted)
- [ ] Experiment config/seed/data hash/commit recorded, if applicable
- [ ] New dated journal entry added; LATEST points to it
- [ ] AI_HANDOFF, STATE, NEXT_STEPS updated
- [ ] Negative findings retained, not edited away
- [ ] Source/copyright/attribution verified
- [ ] Manuscript claims trace to auditable experimental results

## Impact on published or prospective claims

Mark each changed claim `PROVEN`, `VERIFIED COMPUTATIONALLY`, `IMPLEMENTED`, `EXPERIMENTAL`, `CONJECTURED`, `PROPOSED` or `UNKNOWN`. List any unresolved uncertainty.
